links.outcome: Reading level of baseline AAPOS patient education materials versus 6th-grade recommendation
links.effect: Baseline PEMs averaged 9th-grade level (SMOG 9.0 ± 1.6; FKGL 9.6 ± 2.1); only 3.6% met 6th-grade recommendation.
links.quote: Baseline PEMs were written on average at a 9th-grade reading level (SMOG, 9.0 ± 1.6; FKGL, 9.6 ± 2.1), with only 3.6% meeting the 6th-grade recommendation.

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of LLM-rewritten patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 rewrites reached 7th-grade level; Gemini Advanced met 6th-grade threshold with modestly reduced quality; understandability 90.9% and 91.3% (P<0.001); no misinformation.
links.quote: Both models enhanced understandability (ChatGPT-4, 90.9%; Gemini Advanced, 91.3%; [P < 0.001]), and their rewrites contained no misinformation (Likert = 1).
